$comment: What a member reads of the new backup (#1191, lane B, row B16), one case per sentence. Read by crates/screens/tests/backup_page.rs. Both shells draw the same view state the Rust screens build from these words, so there is one fixture and no per-platform copy; the shells' own tests read the generated Words tables, not these. Dates are in the zone below; now_ms is Fri 13 Nov 2026 09:00 UTC; 1795176000000 is Fri 20 Nov 2026 12:00 UTC.
